name: canvas-inbox-plugin
description: Preview and send personalized Canvas Inbox messages to students in teacher-selected live courses, based on grade or course activity.

interface.longDescription: Choose exact live course codes, select students by Canvas grade or recent course activity, review each message, and send separate Inbox conversations as the instructor.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my active Canvas courses, then guide me through conditions, student approval, message drafting, and send approval.
